chars.G: GENERAL SAAD: a stern older man standing very straight like a soldier, wearing a crisp olive-green military-style button cardigan over a white collared shirt, dark navy trousers, polished black shoes, a thick grey mustache.
chars.B: IKRAM: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow headscarf tied back, a lavender long-sleeve tunic with a white kitchen apron, light blue jeans.
chars.M: KHALTI (mother-in-law): a kind plump older woman wearing a deep teal embroidered house djellaba and a white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a big modern Moroccan villa kitchen with green zellige tiles, GENERAL SAAD stands stiffly in the doorway with hands behind his back, staring down hard at IKRAM, who freezes nervously holding a vegetable; KHALTI beside her at the counter glances worried. Comic tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same villa kitchen: GENERAL SAAD points a commanding finger at a large empty aluminium couscoussier pot on the counter, giving an order; IKRAM's eyes go wide in shock, mouth open, comic panic.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: IKRAM alone in the villa kitchen, both mitten hands on her head in comic panic, sweat drops flying, staring at a big sack of couscous semolina and a couscoussier pot.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Villa kitchen: KHALTI steps toward IKRAM smiling kindly to help, but GENERAL SAAD raises a flat hand like a traffic officer to stop her, stern face; IKRAM looks between them helplessly.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: IKRAM stands alone in the big villa kitchen in the evening light, holding a wooden spoon, looking small and lost next to the large couscoussier and a wide clay gasaa dish, comic loneliness.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: IKRAM hides in a corner of the villa kitchen whispering into her phone pressed to her ear, semolina flour spilled on the counter and on her apron, worried face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: IKRAM battling the couscoussier: big clouds of steam burst from the pot, she fans the steam away with a towel while semolina flies, determined comic struggle, Moroccan villa kitchen.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan villa salon at night with low sedari sofas and a round low table; a big gasaa of couscous with vegetables in the middle; GENERAL SAAD sits upright at the head, KHALTI smiles, IKRAM sits stiffly, nervously watching him.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close view at the low round table in the Moroccan salon: GENERAL SAAD slowly chews a first bite of couscous with a serious unreadable face, while IKRAM and KHALTI lean in, frozen, staring at him in suspense, comic tension.
